title: Composition of local finite-free refinements
statement:
theorem exists_condensedQbar_refinement_of_local
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (P : CategoryTheory.Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X))
    (𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X)
    (hC : ∀ (i : 𝒰.I₀), ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage (𝒰.X i),
      ∀ (j : C.I₀), ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty
        ((CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ)
          (C.f j ≫ 𝒰.f i)).obj P ≅
          Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) (C.X j)) r)) :
    ∃ 𝒲 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒲.I₀,
      ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty
        ((CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) (𝒲.f i)).obj P ≅
          Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) (𝒲.X i)) r)

source.place: covering composition axiom for a pretopology

proof.text: Use Classical.skolem to choose a local cover C_i and its member property for each member of the original cover. Mathlib CategoryTheory.Precoverage.ZeroHypercover.bind composes these into a pro-etale cover, using the IsStableUnderComposition instance for Scheme.proetalePrecoverage. Its index type is the sigma type of pairs (i,j), its objects are C_i.X j, and its maps are C_i.f j followed by the original covering map. The local property therefore holds on every composite member by its chosen proof. The Lean proof first performs this construction with the member property as an abstract predicate, then specializes it to the displayed finite-free existence property; both parts are proved in the same module.
